name: Opinion Piece
description: Writes structured opinion articles with a clear thesis, supporting evidence, counterargument acknowledgment, and a persuasive conclusion. Use when the user wants to argue a position, write an editorial, draft a thought leadership piece, or compose a persuasive article. Do NOT use for neutral informational posts (use `blog-post-writing`), listicles (use `listicle-writing`), or academic arguments with citations (use `academic-argument`).
